messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync w/ @Maya and @Luca re: NovaRetail POC — need to lock endpoints + success criteria for week of Apr 12. Customer requires SSO, EU data residency, and low-latency responses on storefront queries.
Maya (Solutions): Primary use case is autocomplete/search suggestions and personalization ranking for product detail pages. Secondary is nightly batch embeddings for catalog similarity. They'll test both.
Dev Patel: Can we get 100 sample search queries + expected top-5 for ranking evals? Also need typical user session length so we can simulate KV cache benefits.
Luca (ML Eng): For interactive endpoints recommend opt-6b-q4 (fast) with a 13b fallback for rare long-form generative tasks. Will need seq len 128 testing. Estimate per-request token cost and P95 latency once we have samples.
Priya (Security): EU-only data flow confirmed. SSO via SAML required. Please attach completed vendor security questionnaire; need answers for encryption at rest, key mgmt, and audit log retention.
Sam (AE): Pricing ask from customer: committed capacity vs PAYG. Ballpark: dedicated 4xA10g pool looks like ~€XXk/month for their expected traffic (TBC). Can sales ops confirm?
Maya (Solutions): Success metrics proposal: P95 latency <800ms for search, relevance NDCG@10 improvement >= 0.15 vs current baseline, embeddings freshness window <24h, error rate <0.1%. Also define acceptable hallucination threshold (FAQ match rate >95%).
Dev Patel: For evals: send prompts + expected outputs. I'll prepare an automated eval harness: scripts, sample labels, and scoring (NDCG, exact match, BLEU where applicable).
Luca (ML Eng): Blockers: we need sample traffic shape, burst patterns, and SAML test idp. I'll run 50qps load on staging once we have inputs. Plan: perf + correctness runs separate.
Priya (Security): Legal will want the vendor questionnaire and any subprocessor list. Also clarify retention policy for derived embeddings.
Sam (AE): Proposed timeline: Week 0 (kickoff + question set), Week 1 (prompt delivery + security questionnaire), Week 2 (staging perf + eval), Week 3 (customer review), Week 4 (pilot decision). Customer requested 4-week pilot.
Maya (Solutions): Action items: I will send prompt set and sample labels by Friday EOD. @Luca please confirm if seq len 128 covers their cases.
Luca (ML Eng): Confirmed—seq128 ok for autocomplete; if they have long prompts we'll flag.
Sam (AE): @Priya please upload questionnaire to the shared folder: https://company.share/NR-poc-sec
Priya (Security): Uploaded. Also added answers re: KMS + EU keys. :thumbsup:
Dev Patel: I'll start the eval harness once prompts arrive. Can someone drop a small data sample (anonymized) into the S3 staging bucket?
Sam (AE): I'll request anonymized sample from customer and cc @Maya.
DeployBot: Meeting created: NovaRetail POC kickoff — Apr 6 10:00 AM CEST. Calendar invite sent.
Maya (Solutions): Anything else? If not, I'll draft the SOW checklist and call out success criteria and acceptance tests.
Sam (AE): Perfect — thanks team. Let's aim to have all blockers raised by Tue so legal/infra have time to review.
